programme.title: PL MASTERCLASS - EP4
programme.desc: Live. Some of the Premier League's biggest stars take us onto the pitch to discuss the techniques and thought processes that allow them to perform at the highest level. Featuring Brentford goalkeepers, Viktor Gyokeres, Callum Hudson-Odoi and Lucas Bergvall.

programme.title: GOALS OF THE SEASON - 2025/2026 (HAALAND)

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP13
programme.desc: Live. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man wh.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP16
programme.desc: Live. John Stones has experienced almost everything the game can offer; from the pressure of the biggest stage to the injuries and setbacks that have tested him along the way. As Stones begins a new life in Italy, we look back at the defining moments, relationships and challenges behind one of England's most decorated p.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP17
programme.desc: Live. From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption stories. Now in love with the game again at Sunderland, Xhaka's story proves that perseverance can define a legacy as much as succes.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP6

programme.title: REVIEW OF THE SEASON - 2025/2026 (ARS)
